{{Quote|And here she comes, the shining jewel in the Organa crown.|[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]] on [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars (radio)">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''House of Organa''', also known as the '''Royal House of Alderaan''', the '''Royal Family of Alderaan''', the '''World Family of Alderaan''', or simply '''House Organa''', was an [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Alderaanian Noble House]] that dated back to the earliest [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] colonization. Throughout history, the Organa dynasty was the one that ruled over their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] the longest. Throughout several millennia of existence, the House Organa sired many well-known figures of the pan&ndash;[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. Two of its most renowned scions were [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and his adopted daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of Alderaan in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the name of Organa died out.

==History==
===Origins===
In the few [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] that followed the fall of [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] developed [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]]. Aboard those transports, groups of Human colonists left [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the purported fountainhead of their [[Species/Legends|species]]. By [[27,500 BBY]], their ships had established colonies on various [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Organa ancestors were among the first to settle that new world, and they played a pivotal role in the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] some 2,500 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="TORcite HO">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Organa}}</ref> In the following [[Time/Legends|millennia]], [[Founding Day]] was celebrated in memory of the foundation of the House of Organa.<ref name="TCW:WS">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>''

The newly-founded [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] society opted for a [[Politics/Legends|political]] system in which a [[Monarch of Alderaan|reigning monarch]] was chosen by and among a number of [[Noble/Legends|noble]] dynasties. House Organa was one of those bloodlines, along with [[House Panteer]], [[House Ulgo]] and [[House Alde]]. As one of the larger houses, the Organa family took smaller, like-minded ones under its protection in exchange for their fealty and support.<ref name="TORcite NH">{{TORcite|type=codex|Noble Houses}}</ref>

===Jedi Civil War===
{{Quote|But the Organa family were powerful rivals of the Ulgos. Some think they were the ones who hired Selven, then they tried to have bounty hunters kill her to keep the secret from coming out.|translated=1|Zax the Hutt|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
Despite its habit of producing heroes, the history of the Organa family had not always been honorable. At some point before the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]] in [[3956 BBY]], the Organas rivaled a [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] branch of House Ulgo, and were believed to have hired the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Selven]] for the assassination of the entire Ulgo family. The Organas later placed a price on Selven's head, supposedly to tie up loose ends.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

===Great Galactic War===
{{Quote|I am Duke Charle Organa, lord of House Organa and heir to the chalcedony star.|Charle Organa|<ref name="SW:TOR" />}}
[[File:First_Organa_Regiment.jpg|thumb|right|200px|During the Alderaan Civil War brought on by the wider conflict between Republic and Sith forces, House Organa possessed their own private military which fought for the Republic.]]
In the following millennia, the Organas remained firm supporters of the Republic, believing in patient negotiation rather than aggression. When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] and [[Prince/Legends|Crown Prince]] [[Gaul Panteer]] announced Alderaan's independence, many Alderaanians were shocked. After the deaths of both Gaul Panteer and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]] prior to the [[Alderaan Civil War]], House Organa, with Galactic Republic backing, made one of many claims to the throne of Alderaan. After the futile attempts to secure the throne diplomatically, House Organa and other prominent houses took matters into their own hands, resulting in the Civil War. [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Charle Remmot Organa]], the patriarch of the House at the time, remained the fiercest ally of the Republic on the planet, determined to restore the peace on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="TORcite HO" />

===Twilight years of the Republic===
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> the House of Organa was a part of the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]] against the [[House of Antilles]], which ended with a [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] between the families.<ref name="Scrambas DB" />

[[File:Leia-ROTScomic.png|thumb|left|200px|Queen Breha, Bail Organa and their foster daughter Leia in 19 BBY]]
Before ascending as Prince, [[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]] and [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of Alderaan, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] served as the Senator of Alderaan in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. He was a contemporary of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SW:ANH" /> Together with his wife [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha]],<ref name="SW:RotS" /> a member of the House of Antilles,<ref name="SW:RotS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Bail adopted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], the daughter of Padmé Amidala and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="SW:RotS" /> The adoption was common knowledge in the court, but even as an adopted daughter Leia took on the title of Princess and became the rightful heir.<ref name="Leia DB">{{DB|character|leiaorganasolo|Solo, Princess Leia Organa}}</ref> Therefore the blood lineage continued only via [[Nial Organa]].<ref name="CotJ" />

Before and during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Organa family maintained a vineyard that produced [[white wine]]. A favorite of Bail Organa, he kept the beverage at hand in his wine cabinet at his [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] apartment.<ref name="TCW:WS" />

At some point prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the House of Organa planned an alliance with [[House Vandron]] from the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. However, the planned marriage between [[Tia Organa]] and a Vandron noble was cancelled following a scandal.<ref name="CotJ" />

Like every Alderaanian royal family, mythology held that the House of Organa was protected by [[Grimtaash/Legends|Grimtaash]] the [[Molator/Legends|molator]].<ref name="CCG Molator">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Molator}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Ogana" was originally the name of a desert planet in the [[The Star Wars first draft|first draft]] of the script of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], which was called [[Utapau (Kessil system)|Utapau]] in the [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]]. In the [[The Star Wars story synopsis|The Star Wars: Story Synopsis]], it was called [[Aquilae (The Star Wars)|Aquilae]], but became a distinct world in later versions. By the second draft, Utapau had become the planet that would be called [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the final script, and [[Ogana Major]] was what became "Organa Major" in the [[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|third draft]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the final script. Organa became Princess Leia's surname in the third draft and that remained the case when her homeworld became Alderaan.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>
